title: Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms
abstract: arXiv:2611.19072v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption

translated_title: Nahual：面向语言与原子的序列模型
translated_abstract: 生成模型在分子设计与模拟中正发挥着日益重要的作用。生成模型最广泛的应用是大语言模型（LLMs），这是因为语言在表达与回答查询方面具有天然的灵活性。然而，通用型LLM无法有效处理大规模的三维坐标集合，而专门的3D分子生成模型又无法达到语言所提供的可控性。为了弥合这两种能力，我们提出了Nahual，一个针对任意文本与3D分子序列的仅解码器自回归扩散模型。为了在连续坐标上实现富有表现力的自回归建模，我们提出了下一词元扩散方法：一个因果Transformer对每个词元进行去噪，同时关注其之前的干净词元，且不会增加上下文长度。我们在精心筛选的十二项3D化学任务上训练了Nahual，任务涵盖从微溶剂化到分子构象搜索再到吸附等多个领域。
tldr: 提出了Nahual——一种基于“下一词元扩散”技术的仅解码器自回归扩散模型，能够统一处理文本与3D分子混合序列的生成，将语言的可控性与3D分子建模能力相结合。
en_tdlr: Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model powered by next-token diffusion, unifies text and 3D molecule generation in a single sequence model, combining the controllability of language with the ability to model 3D molecular structures.
